episodes.name: The Children's Book Job
episodes.summary: A British children's book author comes to Springfield to give a talk at Springfield Elementary School. Homer is tasked with picking her up from the airport, but things go bad from there.

episodes.name: The Jordan Boys' Legacy
episodes.summary: Finding themselves on another planet, Hal and John must put aside their fractured past to solve a murder. Along their journey, both men are forced to confront the ghosts of their pasts... and the ways their childhoods shaped who they are today.

episodes.name: Final Ending: The Last Conclusion
episodes.summary: Fry and his brother sneak into a PG-13 movie as kids... with shocking consequences for the future.

episodes.name: Mac and Dennis Tear Their ACLs
episodes.summary: After a Christmas card catastrophe, Charlie nurses a bedridden Mac and Dennis and deliberates on which one is the originator of all their ideas. Dee and Frank are tired of being the bottom of the communication ladder and decide to flip the script.

episodes.name: Mae Rides the Bus
episodes.summary: Morale is low, but the stakes have never been higher. Mae joins the team on the road. Keeley has news.

episodes.name: Weaponized Honesty
episodes.summary: A chilling injury at camp threatens to send one player home. Two tribes face off in a daunting immunity challenge at sea where one tribe struggles to keep afloat. Then, tribal council takes a wild turn when one player attempts a never-before-seen move to save an ally.

episodes.name: You're Nice
episodes.summary: Isy Suttie unexpectedly mentions eggs, Matt Lucas stares hard at the ceiling, Nina Conti gets very clever in a test, Chloe Petts hides an object somewhere Alex Horne wouldn't dare look, and Richard Ayoade gives the slight impression that he finds some of the tasks a bit irritating. But why is Greg …

episodes.name: Diary of a Chimpy Kid
episodes.summary: Bart and Lisa adopt an abandoned baby chimp and clash over their surprisingly different parenting styles. When the chimp is abducted by a private wild animal zoo, the family goes on a mission to rescue him. Homer is conflicted about saving the ape, because he's convinced the chimp will tear off his…

episodes.name: Dirt and Stars
episodes.summary: As John and Hal draw closer to the truth, John comes to an unexpected understanding with Sheriff Kane... just as a chilling new discovery emerges.

episodes.name: Frank's Team: A Dark Day for Baseball
episodes.summary: In an effort to clean up their image, Paddy's sponsors a local Little League team. But when The Gang spots softness in their franchise, they impose a radical new culture: win no matter what and do whatever it takes to get ahead.

episodes.name: Night of the Living Candace Suits
episodes.summary: An army of Candace Suits terrorizes Danville, and it's up to Candace and Beatrice to stop them.

episodes.name: Terrors of the AltSpace
episodes.summary: Baljeet and Buford get stuck in the space between dimensions known as the AltSpace.

episodes.name: Being Alive
episodes.summary: Season finale. Big changes in bunches.

episodes.name: What I'm Smellin' Is Stinky
episodes.summary: In the wake of a rocky tribal council, a castaway makes a shocking move. A mysterious Tree Mail delivers a game-changing twist. Then, two castaways secretly bond at tribal council in an attempt to change the course of the vote.

episodes.name: To Void An Oblong
episodes.summary: Isy Suttie unexpectedly mentions eggs, Matt Lucas stares hard at the ceiling, Nina Conti gets very clever in a test, Chloe Petts hides an object somewhere Alex Horne wouldn't dare look, and Richard Ayoade gives the slight impression that he finds some of the tasks a bit irritating. But why is Greg …

episodes.name: Ooze
episodes.summary: With business picking up at the Undervale, Katherine is hiring for help. But can the perfect candidate survive the hotel's frightful working conditions?

episodes.name: Dinner Party
episodes.summary: Katherine braces for an unwelcome surprise as Ben throws a hauntingly awkward dinner party for Annabelle. Esther and Abaddon's friendship is tested.

episodes.name: The Witch
episodes.summary: While Katherine and the kids reluctantly support a needy witch, Nathan struggles to open up about his afterlife and Abaddon tackles fiendish food prep.

episodes.name: Ghost Day Out
episodes.summary: Nathan discovers something to "live" for on a once-in-a-generation night when ghosts can roam free. Katherine stays in with an almost angelic Abaddon.

episodes.name: Astral Esther
episodes.summary: After an astral projection mishap, Katherine and Shayna must help Esther find her body. Nathan takes Ben and Abaddon to a mermaid-infested lake.

episodes.name: Dante Crowe
episodes.summary: Gunslinging ghosthunter Dante Crowe checks in, dragging the family into a fight against world-ending omens. Abaddon answers the call of the wild.

episodes.name: The Concierge
episodes.summary: Nathan faces the horrors of politics as Esther runs his campaign for Ghost Mayor. A multi-limbed concierge lends Katherine a hand — much to Ben's dismay.

episodes.name: The Visit
episodes.summary: To save the Undervale, Katherine must recall her first visit to the hotel, when a living Nathan offered her a place to call home amid marital struggles.

episodes.name: The Guys Have a Sleepover
episodes.summary: Blinded from LASIK surgery, Dee pleads for the guys to spend the night to keep her safe from neighborhood crime, but they listen to the wolves inside themselves and opt for a dudes-only sleepover of their own.

episodes.name: No Strings
episodes.summary: Vision embarks on a journey of self-discovery and finds himself hunted by a deadly force.

episodes.name: Theseus
episodes.summary: Vision comes face to face with his assailant while investigating whether Tommy Shepherd is his son.

episodes.name: That's the Magic of Survivor
episodes.summary: In a Tale of Two Tribes, one tribe feels torn apart in the aftermath of a divisive vote-out, while another tribe basks in unity, until an unexpected summoning changes everything. Then, old wounds and previous alliances are put to the test at tribal council.

episodes.name: The Oldest I've Ever Looked
episodes.summary: A former contestant makes an unexpected and dramatic return to the Taskmaster house, but will the current cast give them the respect they undoubtedly deserve?

episodes.name: Treehouse of Horror Presents: The Revengening
episodes.summary: All hell breaks loose on Halloween when a killer comes to Springfield and hacks their way through town. No Simpson is safe from... THE REVENGENING!

episodes.name: Reboot
episodes.summary: Vision and Tommy Shepherd join forces in order to survive while a terrifying killer strikes again.

episodes.name: Malware
episodes.summary: As Vision confronts a new enemy, Ultron and Tommy Shepherd come face to face.

episodes.name: Not Here to Get a Pedicure
episodes.summary: This week's Immunity Challenge comes with double jeopardy when two tribes face tribal council. The Open Era continues its promise when one player receives a never-before-seen advantage. Then, two tribal councils deliver high drama – with tears and a shocking standoff.

episodes.name: The Unfairity
episodes.summary: Richard Ayoade causes controversy while wearing a blindfold, Isy Suttie reveals her revolutionary counting method, Nina Conti invents a new word, Matt Lucas briefly turns into an old-school railwayman, and Chloe Petts is the first contestant in Taskmaster history to draw blood while avoiding flying…

episodes.name: Treehouse of Horror XXXVII
episodes.summary: Bart and Lisa are trapped in an abandoned immersive theme park experience.

episodes.name: I Love Crying
episodes.summary: A bold move to save a castaway at the last tribal council causes fractures to the Dina Tribe. A mysterious meeting will tie the fates of some players together. Then, emotions run hot in a high-stakes challenge that tests the tribe.

episodes.name: A Very Televisual Torso
episodes.summary: Matt Lucas decides to cut the Taskmaster down to size. Nina Conti repeatedly insults a citrus fruit, and Alex Horne delights in making everyone wear aprons.

episodes.name: Halloween 6: The Mirror – Parts One & Two
episodes.summary: A couple of months after Pete's disappearance, while Sam is in Australia on the set of her new film, Polar Opposites, Kyle steps up to help baby-sit the ghosts. Also, Hetty is unexpectedly reunited with her estranged sister, Margaret, and Bela throws an unconventional Halloween bash at Woodstone.

episodes.name: Risky Business
episodes.summary: Dexter struggles to find purpose beyond the hunt as Harrison begins his NYPD career. A brazen new murderer puts the city on edge.

episodes.name: Testing 1-2-3
episodes.summary: In what she argues is not an attempt to get extra time on tests, Lisa has herself evaluated for three types of neurodiversity.. which remind her of behaviors she's witnessed in Principal Skinner, Comic Boy and Homer. Perhaps these atypical behaviors aren't as atypical as we think.

episodes.name: You Broke My Heart Like I was a Girl at the Prom
Big, Clumsy Emu Steps
episodes.summary: It's the grand final and there's only one question left to be answered: how much leg hair does Little Alex Horne have? No, sorry: who is the 22nd Taskmaster champion?

My Rescue Operation Goes Very Wrong
An Old Dead Friend Comes to Visit
I Learn How to Grow Zombies
We Visit the Junkyard of the Gods
Merry Christmas Mr. Plankton
episodes.summary: SpongeBob, Mr. Krabs, and a group of misfits team up to save Christmas when Plankton takes over the North Pole.
